title: Frame Dragging
description: A spinning mass drags spacetime round with it: a gyroscope in orbit round the Earth turns, by forty milliarcseconds a year, for no other reason. Unlocks the Lense-Thirring Vortex Core.

puzzle.goal: A body with angular momentum L drags the spacetime round it. Write the rate Ω at which a gyroscope's axis is turned at distance r, with G and c.
puzzle.name: Lense-Thirring precession
puzzle.ask: Find Ω in milliarcseconds a year (u = @{u}) above the Earth: L = @{L} kg·m²/s, r = @{r} m, G = 6.674e-11, c = 2.998e8.
puzzle.method: The spinning mass makes a gravitomagnetic field, a dipole like a spinning charge's; a gyroscope precesses in it.
